video.title: Table, TableColumn & OutlineGroup | Day 175
video.description:
Learn to explain how to show tables and tree-shaped data in SwiftUI: Table, TableColumn & OutlineGroup, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Table - A view that shows rows of data in sortable columns.
TableColumn - One column of a Table that has a title and a value for each row.
OutlineGroup - A view that shows tree data as rows you can open and close.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Table, TableColumn & OutlineGroup in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
테이블, 테이블컬럼, 아웃라인그룹 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Table - A view that shows rows of data in sortable columns.
한국어: 테이블: 정렬할 수 있는 열로 데이터를 행마다 보여 주는 뷰

TableColumn - One column of a Table that has a title and a value for each row.
한국어: 테이블컬럼: 제목과 행마다의 값을 가진 표의 열 하나

OutlineGroup - A view that shows tree data as rows you can open and close.
한국어: 아웃라인그룹: 트리 구조 데이터를 열고 닫을 수 있는 행으로 보여 주는 뷰

landscape.hook: Can you explain Table, TableColumn and OutlineGroup in English?

dialogue.title: A table of people

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my team list needs columns for name and role.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Table. It shows rows in columns, and users can sort them.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I make the name column?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a TableColumn with a title and a key path, like `\.name`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So each TableColumn reads one value from every row?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Your model must be `Identifiable`, so each row has an `id`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I forgot the `id` and the Table did not compile.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, add it and it works. On iPhone, a Table shows only the first column.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. I also have a folder tree with files inside folders.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does the OutlineGroup find the child folders?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You give it a key path to the children, like `kids`.
Use a Table for rows and columns.
